greeting: You land in Dubrovnik this afternoon, Dan. Tonight, on solid ground with real wifi, is the window to lock the sailing logistics before the boat cuts you off Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat arrival logistics
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 transfer from Komolac to Cavtat, the hotel bag-hold, and the early Sunday checkout all still need arranging, and all have to be done from dry land before you board Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Open since Sept 5: confirm Saturday's boarding time and place, and the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport, before connectivity drops aboard.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 SUV
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge. Book the full-size SUV out of TPA outright so you're not at walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Close the St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20 to 22 nights are still unbooked, and the pending St Pete Airbnb for Sept 27 to Oct 5 is worth a glance to confirm it converted.

schedule.title: Check in at the Old Port apartment
schedule.detail: Kneza Damjana Jude, Dubrovnik, Sep 9 to 12

flagged.title: Valoris still owes you a call
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano flagged that you two need to connect on the Nomura and Japan intermediaries work.

flagged.title: Dubrovnik check-in details arrived
flagged.detail: The host sent the Old Port apartment address and welcome for tonight.

flagged.title: BA Visa payment posted
flagged.detail: Chase confirmed your British Airways card payment went through.

inbox.noise: Otherwise travel receipts and promos: baggage, PayPal, Booking.com, a couple of newsletters.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox needs a reply today.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are at their crisp, tart peak—perfect for baking into something rich.

acts.line: A Frankfurt layover behind you, the napcabs cabin having done its job overnight.
One short hop to Dubrovnik, wheels down around five local time.
Settle into the Old Port flat, then clear the sailing logistics while you still have signal.
